verdict: no endpoint — the amounts are in the pricing page's own HTML; USD only, so still not counted in AW (AWG needed)
how_confirmed: Downloaded the raw HTML of https://www.restolabs.com/pricing once (HTTP 200, 337 KB). The only fetch() calls in it go to https://ipapi.co/json/ (IP location for the demo form) — no endpoint on restolabs.com or anywhere else loads prices. The '$00' placeholders are 00; an inline jQuery/GSAP script ('INITIAL PRICE SETUP') replaces the text with data-year (default 'Billed Annually') and switches to data-month on the toggle. The same amounts are also in the page's schema.org JSON-LD 'offers' with priceCurrency USD.

notes: Basic plan JSON-LD description: 'Pickup and in-house delivery, 50+ payment gateways, order management app, loyalty suite, and real-time analytics.' No AWG / Afl anywhere on the page and no currency selector, so Restolabs stays uncounted in AW (USD). The JSON-LD areaServed lists US CA GB FI ES FR DE IT CH AE AU CL EC BR (not AW; Aruba presence is from its case study). Caveat: the visible amounts are script-filled from HTML attributes; the plain-text quotes are from JSON-LD (machine-readable, not visible text).
